design: Learned conditional world model G_theta(r_{t+1..t+h} | x_t) over the PIT daily Kraken panel (~273 assets, true UTC bars via trader/data.py, market-residual Yang-Zhang-standardised target), conditioned on a 60-day OHLCV window, serving Monte Carlo leaf evaluation V_K(w) = (1/K) sum_k u(w . r^k - c|w - w_prev|) inside the existing Gumbel/sampled search (828 operator, pw0.0, E5-inversion3 shape) or a sample-average-approximation Garleanu-Pedersen program. Three arms: G0 closed-form conditional Gaussian (ridge mean, HAR-RV/Yang-Zhang vol, Ledoit-Wolf covariance); G1 neural conditional flow/diffusion or RSSM (Dreamer/PlaNet class); G2 Bella re-trained on daily bars (TASK_722/778 ansatz; the resident Bella is a minute-bar, 64-survivor-asset, window-400 generator and cannot serve as-is). Inventory/cost dynamics are known exactly (jax_trading_env.py:1608-1772, every fee term x fee_rate), so the only learned component is the price law. The proposal's own accounting: profit_source = forecast; BEAR-positive without a forecast = no; P(clears goalposts) ~1-2%; claimed residual value = (1) calibrated null-distribution engine for the memo's IC instrument, (2) R4 stress / sizing / no-trade band, (3) execution-style calibration.

strongest_objection: The best case against this refutation has three parts. (1) The iterated-expectations identity binds only relative to the generator's information set, and the memo's F1-F4 feature families are hand-chosen; a learned 60-day multivariate context could expose conditional-mean structure that ridge/GBM on F1-F4 miss, and the record's "nonlinear <= linear" is thin on THIS surface — 811 is a minute-scale result (modeling_surface_exhausted.md), 819 CAPACITY is 20 assets, close-only, pooled IC, pre-E-c, with a four-draw noise floor (memo E-2, cap_aggregate.py:46-57). (2) The proposal's own evidence base is weaker than stated but so is the "mu = 0" premise: the 2026-08-19 correction (LEDGER.md:109-120; pathfinder_audit:40) says 887 does NOT establish absent edge — the trend teacher's actions are positive-EV at fee0 in-window (tier-0 floor +1.19) and 887's books were net short in a +10.3% market — so "the fixed point at mu=0 reproduces 887" is not a clean demonstration that mu = 0, and 892's anti-edge is about one BC recipe's maintenance re-trims. (3) 879 measured the search wrapper subtractive with a LEARNED v-hat leaf; an exact-cost MC leaf under proportional costs / CVaR is not the same object, so "the wrapper is inert" is unmeasured for THIS leaf. Why none of it rescues the design: (1) is a supervised-forecaster claim — a likelihood-trained generator estimates E[r|x] with strictly more nuisance parameters than a regression targeted at it, so if the structure exists a forecaster column (MLP / flow-implied mean) in the IC grid finds it first and better, and the rollout leaf only adds O(sigma_w/sqrt(K)) noise on top; the loop is not the instrument that answers the doubt. (2) cuts against the proposal's receipts, not against the refutation: even granting findable edge, that edge is the trend teacher's, measured dead since 2024 (898: net@8 2024 +0.041, 2026H1 -1.659; spot-legal long-flat -5.221 CI[-7.89,-2.09]), and the design has no mechanism to find a different one. (3) is pre-registered by the proposal itself to lose ("expected: MC leaf below GP at all K") and belongs, by memo §4.5, to the G-B-passes/G-C-fails branch — downstream of an IC PASS the record has never produced.
amplifier_check: VERDICT: AMPLIFIER ONLY, with a negative information term from rollout noise; the one place it claims to create information (a calibrated null) is dominated by a model-free estimator. Decompose the learned object P(r_{t+1:t+h}|x_t) into mu(x), Sigma(x), higher moments, within-horizon dependence. mu(x) is the only term that can move expected gross: for any causal book w_t, E[sum w_t . r_{t+1}] = E[sum w_t . mu_t]; at mu = 0 every rule has E[gross] = 0 and E[net] = -turnover x 21 bp, so the design fails the HOLD-positions and BEAR-positive goalposts by construction unless mu != 0 — and mu is exactly what a supervised forecaster estimates, more efficiently. Sigma/tails/dependence are closed-form estimable (Yang-Zhang, HAR-RV, Ledoit-Wolf — the proposal's own arm G0), move only the denominator and the cost term, and on the current zero-drift book (898: "the program currently has NO positive-expectancy fallback") are worth 0 Sharpe; on a book with drift they are the tactics panel's row 4, not a loop. The MC leaf SUBTRACTS information: per-candidate noise sigma_w/sqrt(K) (~22 bp at K=256 on a 60%-vol book vs ~7 bp/day expected return at IC 0.02), then an argmax over noisy candidate scores — the winner's-curse-to-turnover mechanism the record already measured with an EXACT leaf (E5-inversion2: true-env leaf at fee16 -4.88/-1.44, hold 55-68% "trajectory churn"; 831x/D: candidates K16->K128 +5.29->+4.68, "extra candidates buy TURNOVER TAX"). The self-learning half (a Dreamer/ExIt actor trained inside G) is the 887/892 distillation loop with a learned simulator in place of the real one, plus 758's sim-to-real term (per-step oracle PnL 7x too easy, notes_2026-05-18.md:87-96; 758 SPEC:257-263 — measured NULL under the canonical operator, encoder_bella_class_closed.md recharacterisation). The claimed created information — a "no conditional mean, realistic dependence" null for the IC instrument — fails the test: a circular-shift placebo (feature panel time-shifted against the return panel, M >= 200 shifts) preserves the TRUE vol clustering, cross-sectional correlation, N_eff and tails exactly and model-free, is already on the tactics panel (fable_tactics_panel_2026-09-04.md:115), costs CPU-minutes, and answers the memo's E-2 objection (cap_aggregate.py:46-57 takes the max of FOUR shuffle draws — a draw-count defect, not a shuffle-family defect). A generator null is a parametric approximation of that placebo and inherits the generator's artefacts (over-smooth paths would inject spurious lag-return IC into the null, miscalibrating it). Worth if daily IC ~ 0: zero as alpha, negative as a leaf, and ~0 marginal as a null engine. Net: the loop creates no information a direct estimator lacks.

surviving_claim: Nothing survives as a self-learning loop, a world model in the tree, or a Bella/Dreamer/MuZero-with-generative-dynamics direction; the "Bella as world-model rollouts inside MCTS" carve-out (encoder_bella_class_closed.md:29; TASK_722/778 DRAFTs) can be closed on argument — iterated expectations over known inventory dynamics, E5-exit2's lookahead insight, 849/leaf, 879's subtractive wrapper — without a GPU run. What does survive, none of it a loop: (a) the generator's implied conditional mean is a FORECASTER and belongs, if anywhere, as one extra estimator column in the memo's §4 IC grid (an MLP or flow-implied-mean cell, <=1 GPU-day on one 24 GB card), as a hedge against the one open doubt the record cannot yet close — that F1-F4 with ridge/GBM miss nonlinear/interaction structure on the PIT daily surface (819 CAPACITY is too weak an instrument to close it); it is graded by the same G-A gate and adds nothing beyond a forecaster if it passes; (b) closed-form second moments (Yang-Zhang sigma, HAR-RV, Ledoit-Wolf) for sizing, no-trade bands and turnover reduction on a book WITH drift — the tactics panel's row 4, worth ~0 Sharpe on the current zero-drift book and never BEAR-positivity; (c) the null for the IC instrument should be the circular-shift placebo (M>=200), model-free, already on the panel, not a generator. Compute: nothing here needs 64 GB GPUs (agreeing with fable_tactics_panel:134-135); the sequencing is STEP-0 hull (minutes) -> IC-ceiling instrument (CPU-days) -> optional forecaster column. Odds this design changes the goalposts outcome relative to the memo's plan: ~0; its marginal value in the G-A PASS world is also ~0 because GP closed form on the same mu is expected to match or beat the MC leaf (the proposal's own Stage 3 pre-registration). The operator's half-expectation is correct.
kill_experiment_critique: The kill experiment is mostly not a test of the design. Stage 1 (IC of mu_hat_G vs ridge, paired, by year) tests a FORECASTER — it is one extra column in the memo's 160-cell grid and should be filed as such, with Bonferroni over the WHOLE grid (the proposal says 'over the added cells', which under-corrects a shared SPEC). Stage 2 (QLIKE vs HAR-RV) tests second-moment skill that arm G0 estimates closed-form — a PASS licenses sizing rows the tactics panel already lists, and the realised-variance target 'from the minute cache' cannot cover 2026H1 past the minute table's 2026-03 end, so the by-year requirement 'in each year' is unmeetable as written for 2026H1. Stage 3 is the ONLY stage that tests the loop (MC leaf vs Garleanu-Pedersen on identical mu_hat/Sigma_hat), and it is pre-registered by the proposal to lose ('MC leaf below GP at all K') — it re-runs 879's subtractive-wrapper finding with an exact leaf; fine as a <=2 GPU-hour confirmation, but it cannot rescue the design and is downstream of a G-A PASS that does not exist. Stage 4 (758 oracle-PnL ratio in [0.7,1.4]) reuses a MINUTE-scale path-solver quantity by name; on daily 21-day paths the per-step normalisation must be redefined and pre-registered, since the 758 SPEC itself records 0.03x (cum) vs 7x (per-step) for the same runs (SPEC.md:254-263). Structural defects: (i) the instrument `experiments/9xx_ic_ceiling/` does not exist, so 'shared with the memo's instrument' is a dependency on an unwritten SPEC and the 14-day clock cannot start; (ii) the one thing the proposal calls structurally new — the generator null — has NO cell testing it: add a calibration cell comparing the generator-null IC distribution to the circular-shift placebo distribution (M>=200 each); if they agree within CI the generator is redundant, if they disagree the generator is the suspect (758's smoothness would inflate lag-return IC under the 'null'); (iii) G2 (Bella on daily bars) is a new build costing more than the rest combined and is optional on a G1 pass that the proposal gives 3-5% — drop it from the pre-registration or the kill date is fiction; (iv) the pass condition 'IC(mu_hat_G) - IC(ridge) >= +0.01 with paired t >= 3 in each of 2024/2025/2026H1' is fine, but the consequence on PASS should be 'a forecaster cell passed', never 'the world model passed' — write that sentence into the SPEC so the verdict cannot be read as licensing the loop. Correct sequencing per the record: STEP-0 tactic hull (tactics panel row 1, minutes) -> memo §4 IC instrument with the placebo null (CPU-days) -> optional forecaster column (this proposal's Stage 1, <=1 GPU-day) -> Stage 3 only if G-B passes and G-C fails. No 64 GB hardware is justified by any stage.
